## States

| Category | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `triage` | Awaiting a decision to accept the ticket. |
| `todo` | Accepted and queued. |
| `in-progress` | Being worked; a lease is held. |
| `done` | Terminal; carries an outcome. |

A ticket in `done` carries one outcome:

| Outcome | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `fixed` | The work was completed and verified. |
| `wont-fix` | Deliberately not done. |
| `duplicate` | Another ticket covers it. |
| `invalid` | The report is not valid. |
| `done` | Completed work with nothing to fix (a feature, a chore). |

## Handles

A handle is `~` plus the shortest suffix of a ticket's random id part that no other ticket shares, never shorter than `handle_min_len`. In this repository `handle_min_len` is 7, so handles are at least 7 characters (at most 16).
